questions.explanation:
LINE-BY-LINE WALKTHROUGH
`name = 'Aylin'` — Binds the evaluated expression to a name; without the assignment, later lines cannot reuse that result.
`print(name[0], name.upper())` — Runs an expression; print displays a value and calls may have side effects—without the line, that action does not occur.
